profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at OpenGov
profile.summary: I am a Senior Software Engineer with a background in cloud computing and a proven track record of stabilizing and scaling distributed systems. I am interested in remote software engineering positions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building OpenGov's next generation Utility Billing application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Workflows Platform Team

Team Lead of the Workflow Executions team (4 software engineers). Drove the growth of nearly 50x traffic over 4 years, from 100 million annual executions to 4.7 billion annual executions.

Stabilized the inherited AWS SWF based system for workflow executions, uncovering numerous bottlenecks and reliability issues. Refactored the monolithic service into microservices for improved scalability and consistency. Transformed an error-prone unstable system to a self-sufficient one, significantly reducing operational burden and increasing platform availability. 

Identified the nonviability of the current architecture to meet long-term customer needs and analyzed the technical feasibility of restructuring the system to enable better scale.

Migrated the underlying workflow orchestration platform from SWF to Temporal, enabling the platform to support 10x scale. This complex yearlong project required rewriting the system from Javascript to Golang and integrating with new frameworks and libraries.

Developed COVID-19 testing and contact tracing solutions for state and local governments and schools, utilizing Qualtrics Workflows, AWS Lambdas, and Google Maps SDKs. This software was the official testing and contact tracing software for the states of Utah, Nebraska, and Iowa and generated $25 million in Annual Contract Value (ACV) and $25 million in license renewals, roughly 25% of company revenue during that time period.

Drove the investigation and implementation to improve scalability for secrets management service to save $2 million annually through reduced resource allocation and software licensing costs.

As a stretch goal, identified over-allocated AWS Elasticache instances, cleaning up obsolete data, resizing instances, and migrating to reserved instances to reduce annual cost from $905k to $38k.
positions.insights: Software Design, Technical Staff Management and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Azure Fabric Controller Team

As a member of the Microsoft Azure Core Compute organization, I wrote software that monitors and manages the virtual machines and physical servers in Azure’s datacenters.

Developed and deployed the monitoring services, telemetry, and configurations used to ensure health and optimal uptime for all Azure datacenters. 

Streamlined settings updates from ~2 weeks to ~2 days for the entire Azure fleet by developing a settings configuration library to automate application of configuration updates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the Android team, implementing various new features and improvements on Clover's Android applications. 

Developed the Clover Dashboard prototype, Clover’s first mobile application that provides merchants with real-time data from their Clover point-of-sale devices on their phones. Published on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 

Built a utility tool to optimize and shrink Clover's base SDK. Reduced the size of the SDK by 10%.

Worked closely with designers and engineers on new projects, gaining valuable experience in cross-disciplinary teams of engineers, managers, and designers to bridge front and back end functionality.

Managed databases through MySQL.

projects.title: WhyIsTheTowerOrange
projects.description: First Android mobile app that I developed that displays the current status of the U.T. tower (it burns orange on certain occasions such as a sports team victory or academic achievement). The app interacts with information from the Internet in an AsyncTask via HttpClient. It implements basic Android features such as Activities, Intents, PopupWindows, AsyncTasks, Layouts, ScrollView, Buttons, ImageViews, and TextViews.
